hero.subtitle: Alfredo Zanetti is a Perth-based photographer shooting fashion campaigns, model portfolios and portraits with an editorial, documentary sensibility.

about.title:
Trained to read a room,
now trained on a lens.
paragraphs: Before picking up a camera, Alfredo Zanetti studied sociology — reading status, movement and tension in a room. That same instinct now shapes every campaign, portfolio and portrait he shoots across Perth.

The result is a body of work that blends controlled studio portraiture with the spontaneity and sensitivity developed through his background in street photography: clean, cinematographic images built around real posture, intentional lighting and the everyday texture of the city.

services.title: Essential Package
services.description: 45-minute session, studio or on-location. 15 professionally edited photos and an online gallery for selection. Perfect for personal portraits, basic branding and social media content.

services.title: Professional Package
services.description: 1.5 hours across studio and one outdoor location, with 2–3 outfit changes. 25 professionally edited photos, online gallery and high-resolution downloads. For creators and professionals building a consistent visual identity.

services.title: Signature Experience
services.description: Up to 3 hours across studio and multiple outdoor locations, 1–2 models, unlimited wardrobe changes. 40 professionally edited photos, an optional short BTS video and a private gallery. For full branding sessions, creative concepts and model portfolios.

intro.title: A clean, cinematic and natural aesthetic.
intro.paragraph: Alfredo Zanetti is a Perth-based photographer. His work is defined by a clean, cinematic aesthetic that captures the authenticity and emotion of every person in front of his camera.

legal.title: Public Liability Coverage
legal.description: On-location and public-space shoots are covered by public liability insurance.

legal.title: Permit Coordination
legal.description: Council permits for beaches, bridges and other public Perth locations are arranged ahead of the shoot.

legal.title: Agency-Spec Delivery
legal.description: 300 DPI, vertical 4:5 / 9:16 crops and true-texture retouching, ready for agency submission.

faq.question: How far in advance should I book?
faq.answer: For campaigns and model portfolios, 2–3 weeks' notice is recommended to allow time for planning, location scouting and permits where needed.

faq.question: What's included in a shoot package?
faq.answer: Every package includes pre-shoot planning, the session itself and a set of fully edited, delivery-ready images. Exact deliverables are confirmed in your quote.

faq.question: Do you travel outside Perth?
faq.answer: Yes — shoots outside the metro area can be arranged, with travel costs quoted separately.

faq.question: What's the turnaround time for edited images?
faq.answer: Standard turnaround is 5–10 business days, depending on the size of the shoot.

faq.question: Do you require a deposit?
faq.answer: Yes, a deposit secures your date. The remaining balance is due on delivery of the final images.
